findings.finding: getPrivateEvents completes ensureContractSynced before applying requested block range; autoSync:false does not disable contract sync.
Completion includes note nullifiers and sync_state; nested/speculative sync contributors must settle.
Discovery advances tag windows across finalized history and accumulates all logs; page limits do not bound total work.
All tag batches and all per-tag afterLog pages are consumed. Node cursor primitive exists but PXE exposes no bounded incremental contract-sync API.
All handshake pages derive secrets before pending-log processing; normal processing also handles offchain inbox and pending partial notes.
Nullifier sync scans scoped active notes. Event acceptance must preserve commitment, siloed-nullifier membership and authenticated transaction/block validation.
Failure drains contributors then aborts whole changeset. A capacity throw alone cannot retain incremental recovery progress; partial return must not be cached as synced.
Persisted aged/finalized indices have no-op rollback by design; unfinalized partial cursors require distinct canonical-anchor/rollback semantics.

proposedOnly.interface: Explicit incomplete scoped sync-step, using original operation queue and normal Noir validation; atomic validated data plus continuation commit; no synced cache until complete.
proposedOnly.bounds: Before secret/tag/page fan-out and byte allocation; separate handshake enumeration and note-nullifier scans. Drain all started work on errors; no Promise.race or lowered anchor.
